name: Mira
source:
The present manager of the Resting Bean Cafe. Mira tends to be secretive about her past. To date, no one has learned much about her. She can be stern, but seems friendly during most interactions.

Mira is a perfectionist with expensive tastes, but Sophie has noticed that she’s rather lazy when it comes to manual work, and would prefer to offload her responsibilities on others.
